title: Division-Free Reciprocal Algorithm via Newton's Method
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Derive Newton's iteration formula to compute 1/a without performing division by finding the root of f(x) = 1/x - a.

steps.title: Apply Newton's Formula
steps.mathExpression: x_{n+1} = x_n - \frac{\frac{1}{x_n} - a}{-\frac{1}{x_n^2}} = x_n + x_n^2\left(\frac{1}{x_n} - a\right) = x_n + x_n - ax_n^2 = 2x_n - ax_n^2 = x_n(2 - ax_n)
steps.explanation: The resulting formula requires only addition, subtraction, and multiplication (no division!).
steps.why: Used in computer processor arithmetic units for hardware division.
